name: Shore
description_en:
Shore combines online booking and customer management with optional marketing and point-of-sale products for service businesses. The English Europe website describes a workflow from booking and deposit through staff/resource scheduling to an iPad register and accounting export.

Those are product-family capabilities, not a single universal subscription. Booking, POS and their combined package have separate prices and regional conditions. A business should choose the required operational path before comparing the monthly figure.
description_zh:
Shore 结合在线预约与客户管理，并为服务业务提供可选营销及收银产品。欧洲英文网站描述从预约、订金、员工/资源排程，到 iPad 收银及财务导出的流程。

这些是产品家族能力，不是一个通用订阅。Booking、POS 及组合套餐有不同价格和地区条件。比较月费前，应先确定需要的运营路径。

core_features.explanation_en: Offer online booking, reminders and customer details in the scheduling product.
core_features.explanation_zh: 在排程产品中提供在线预约、提醒及客户资料。

core_features.explanation_en: POS products add payment, receipt and inventory functions under regional and hardware conditions.
core_features.explanation_zh: POS 产品在地区和硬件条件下加入付款、收据及库存能力。

en: A beauty business can define a treatment, the staff who deliver it and the room or equipment it occupies. A customer books online and may pay a deposit; after service, a POS-enabled business can take the remaining payment and issue a receipt. The homepage describes these stages together, but the correct plan and payment setup must cover them.
zh: 美容业务可以定义项目、交付员工及占用房间或设备。客户在线预约并可能支付订金，服务后启用 POS 的企业可收取余款并开收据。首页将这些阶段串联介绍，但所选套餐及支付配置必须覆盖实际流程。
use_cases.basis: Illustrative evaluation workflow; no customer adoption or savings measured.

pricing.billing_basis: EUR business subscriptions excluding VAT, annual/monthly choices, separate hardware/TSE and quoted processing fees.

official_check.scope: Public official documents only; no account, purchase, hands-on test, independent review, identity or publication approval.

review_notes: Original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese translation from attached official sources. Product behavior is vendor-documented, not independently tested.
All records remain draft. Chinese prose does not establish a Chinese software interface.

sections.title_en: Example: an appointment with room and checkout
sections.title_zh: 示例：同时涉及房间和收银的预约
sections.en:
A beauty business can define a treatment, the staff who deliver it and the room or equipment it occupies. A customer books online and may pay a deposit; after service, a POS-enabled business can take the remaining payment and issue a receipt. The homepage describes these stages together, but the correct plan and payment setup must cover them.

Evaluate a staff absence, a room collision and a canceled deposit booking. Inspect the customer history, reservation and payment reference separately. No booking or register operation was run here, and the promotional no-show claims are not independent evidence.
sections.zh:
美容业务可以定义项目、交付员工及占用房间或设备。客户在线预约并可能支付订金，服务后启用 POS 的企业可收取余款并开收据。首页将这些阶段串联介绍，但所选套餐及支付配置必须覆盖实际流程。

建议评估员工缺勤、房间冲突及取消订金预约，分别核对客户历史、预约及支付引用。本次未运行预约或收银操作，宣传中的爽约改善也不是独立证据。

sections.title_en: Separate Booking from POS and add-ons
sections.title_zh: 区分 Booking、POS 和附加项
sections.en:
The EUR page shows Booking at €59.90 monthly or €49.90 per month paid annually, Booking + Marketing at €79.90/€69.90, and All-in-One at €129.90/€119.90. POS and POS+ are separate offers. Prices target businesses and exclude VAT. Annual payment normally has a twelve-month initial term; cancellation notice is described separately in the FAQ.

Cloud TSE is listed at €9 monthly and hardware is separately priced. Card-processing terms are based on sales and require a quote. A fixed subscription or “no commissions” statement should not be treated as free card processing, free hardware or a universal tax-inclusive price.
sections.zh:
欧元页面列出 Booking 月付 €59.90、年付月均 €49.90；Booking + Marketing 为 €79.90/€69.90，All-in-One 为 €129.90/€119.90。POS 和 POS+ 为独立方案。价格面向企业，未含增值税。年付通常初始十二个月，取消通知期在 FAQ 另列。

Cloud TSE 列为每月 €9，硬件另行定价。银行卡处理条件按销售额询价。固定订阅或“不收佣金”不能理解为刷卡处理、硬件免费，或全球通用含税价格。

sections.en:
The pricing page explicitly restricts POS availability to Germany, Austria and Switzerland. Its TSE, KassenSichV and DATEV references describe regional accounting/compliance context; they are not proof of fitness for another jurisdiction. The product uses browsers for management and an iPad app plus compatible peripherals for POS.

Prepare services, schedules, customer data, product stock and hardware before migration. Confirm staff permissions and the exact booking/payment channels in a demonstration. The advertised 14-day test does not establish indefinite free use. No self-hosting licence, offline checkout or disaster recovery was verified.
sections.zh:
定价页明确 POS 仅在德国、奥地利及瑞士提供。TSE、KassenSichV 和 DATEV 属于地区财务/合规背景，不能证明适合其他法域。管理使用浏览器，POS 需要 iPad 应用及兼容外设。

迁移前准备服务、日程、客户资料、商品库存及硬件，通过演示确认员工权限与具体预约/支付渠道。宣传的 14 天测试不代表长期免费。未核实自托管许可、离线结算或灾难恢复。

sections.title_en: Inspect the record before repeating a charge
sections.title_zh: 重复扣款前先检查记录
sections.en:
For a booking that lacks confirmation, compare the source calendar and customer record. For an uncertain payment, reconcile the receipt and processor transaction before repeating checkout. The public pages describe backups and automation but do not demonstrate restoration or guarantee that an arbitrary downstream failure is reversed.

Shore is worth evaluating for service businesses wanting appointment and front-desk operations together, especially where its regional POS is available. A pure meeting-link requirement or an unsupported-country register project needs a different scope assessment.
sections.zh:
预约缺少确认时，先对照来源日历及客户记录；付款状态不确定时，重复结算前核对收据和处理商交易。公开页面介绍备份及自动化，但未演示恢复，也不保证任意下游失败都会冲正。

希望把预约及前台运营结合的服务业务，可以评估 Shore，尤其在其地区 POS 可用时。单纯会议链接或不支持地区的收银项目，需要另行判断范围。

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
content_method.method: Public primary-source research, original English editorial synthesis and Chinese translation. Examples and evaluation recommendations were not executed.

research_gaps.en: No payment, deposit refund, POS hardware, data migration, regional compliance, export or restore was tested; final licence and processing terms remain unverified.
research_gaps.zh: 未测试付款、订金退款、POS 硬件、迁移、地区合规、导出或恢复；最终许可及处理条款未核实。
